mapper.sql: r.id,r.resource_no AS resourceNo,r.institution_id AS institutionId,r.resource_type AS resourceType,r.title,r.subtitle,r.description,r.file_id AS fileId,r.status,r.created_by AS createdBy,r.updated_by AS updatedBy,r.created_at AS createdAt,r.updated_at AS updatedAt,r.version

sql.if: AND (r.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR r.subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR r.description LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_institution_merchant_resource r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.resource_no=#{resourceNo}
SELECT FROM crm_institution_merchant_resource r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM crm_institution_merchant_resource r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT i.id AS institutionId, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.resource_type='DOCTOR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS doctorCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.resource_type='EQUIPMENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS equipmentCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.resource_type='CASE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS caseCount FROM crm_institution i LEFT JOIN crm_institution_merchant_resource r ON r.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND r.institution_id=i.id AND r.status='PUBLISHED' WHERE i.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND i.archived=0
GROUP BY i.id ORDER BY i.id
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_institution_merchant_resource SET title=#{title},subtitle=#{subtitle},description=#{description},file_id=#{fileId},status=#{status}, updated_by=#{updatedBy},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion}
